metadata.description: Mods that enforce and route the coordinator skills of this repository.

plugins.name: model-guard
plugins.description: Enforces model-mix on delegated launches: Sonnet for general-purpose and Plan agents launched without a model, Haiku 5.5 at medium effort for Explore agents and the haiku alias only where it is Haiku 5.5 (Claude Code 2.1.293+ on the Anthropic API), Haiku 4.5 refused, Fable kept off agents, forks, workflow agents, routines and shell launches (custom agents are judged at spawn), workflow width capped by today's profile, --model on cloud and headless launches, no new launches on a red budget or a paused 5-hour window. Resumes pass while red but wait while the 5-hour window is paused; messages to workers, git, gh and merges always pass, unless the git command itself runs claude (git bisect run). With no usage reading, or a green one older than 10 minutes, launches pass with one line, unattended runs included; an older red or yellow reading keeps holding. Run cost, credits, the Fable window and the Haiku stage and context rules stay with the model.

plugins.name: skill-router
plugins.description: Smart activation of skills with no model cost: suggests the skill a message calls for and asks once for the skills a workflow, agent, cloud launch, merge or mod edit needs; messages sent directly to workers and subagent calls are never held, and a gate that fails lets the call through.
